questions.stem: Six people A, B, C, D, E, F sit in a circle facing the centre. A is immediately to the left of B. D sits opposite A. C is immediately to the right of B. F sits between E and A (E–F–A clockwise). E sits opposite B. Arrangement (clockwise): A–B–C–D–E–F. Who sits immediately to the right of D?
questions.explanation: Clockwise order: A(1)–B(2)–C(3)–D(4)–E(5)–F(6). D is at position 4; the person immediately to its right (clockwise) is at position 5 = **E**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Six people A, B, C, D, E, F sit in a circle facing the centre. Clockwise order: A–B–C–D–E–F. In a 6-person circle, people 3 seats apart are opposite each other. Who sits opposite C?
questions.explanation: C is at position 3. Opposite (3 seats away) = position 3+3 = 6 = **F**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Six people A, B, C, D, E, F sit in a circle facing the centre. Clockwise order: A–B–C–D–E–F. Who sits immediately to the left of C (i.e., counterclockwise neighbour of C)?
questions.explanation: C is at position 3. Counterclockwise (left when facing centre) from position 3 = position 2 = **B**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Six people A, B, C, D, E, F sit in a circle facing the centre. Clockwise order: A–B–C–D–E–F. Who sits second to the right of A?
questions.explanation: A is at position 1. Second to the right (clockwise): position 1+2 = 3 = **C**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Six people A, B, C, D, E, F sit in a circle facing the centre. Clockwise order: A–B–C–D–E–F. Who are the two immediate neighbours of F?
questions.explanation: F is at position 6. Its clockwise neighbour is position 1 = A; its counterclockwise neighbour is position 5 = E. Neighbours = **A and E**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Eight people P, Q, T, R, S, U, V, W sit in a circle facing the centre. P is immediately to the left of Q. T is immediately to the right of Q. R is immediately to the right of T. S is opposite P. V is between U and W (U–V–W clockwise). Clockwise order: P–Q–T–R–S–U–V–W. Who sits immediately to the right of S?
questions.explanation: S is at position 5. Immediately to the right (clockwise) = position 6 = **U**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Eight people sit in a circle (clockwise): P–Q–T–R–S–U–V–W. In an 8-person circle, persons 4 seats apart are directly opposite each other. Who sits opposite R?
questions.explanation: R is at position 4. Opposite = position 4+4 = 8 = **W**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Eight people sit in a circle (clockwise): P–Q–T–R–S–U–V–W. Who sits second to the right of Q?
questions.explanation: Q is at position 2. Second to the right = position 2+2 = 4 = **R**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Eight people sit in a circle (clockwise): P–Q–T–R–S–U–V–W. Who sits 4th to the right of P?
questions.explanation: P is at position 1. 4th to the right = position 1+4 = 5 = **S**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Eight people sit in a circle (clockwise): P–Q–T–R–S–U–V–W. Who sits directly opposite V?
questions.explanation: V is at position 7. Opposite = position 7+4 = 11 ≡ 3 (mod 8) = position 3 = **T**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Six people Ram, Sham, Hari, Kiran, Nitu, and Puja sit in a circle facing the centre. Ram and Kiran sit opposite each other. Sham is immediately to the right of Ram. Hari is immediately to the right of Sham. Nitu sits between Kiran and Puja. Clockwise order: Ram–Sham–Hari–Kiran–Nitu–Puja. Who is to the immediate right of Nitu?
questions.explanation: Nitu is at position 5. Immediately to the right (clockwise) = position 6 = **Puja**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Six people sit in a circle (clockwise): Ram–Sham–Hari–Kiran–Nitu–Puja. In a 6-person circle, persons 3 seats apart are opposite. Who sits opposite Sham?
questions.explanation: Sham is at position 2. Opposite = position 2+3 = 5 = **Nitu**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Six people sit in a circle (clockwise): Ram–Sham–Hari–Kiran–Nitu–Puja. Who sits second to the left of Kiran?
questions.explanation: Kiran is at position 4. Second to the left (counterclockwise) = position 4−2 = 2 = **Sham**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Six people sit in a circle (clockwise): Ram–Sham–Hari–Kiran–Nitu–Puja. How many people sit between Ram and Hari when counted clockwise from Ram?
questions.explanation: Going clockwise from Ram(1) to Hari(3): we pass Sham(2). Only **1** person sits between them.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Six people sit in a circle (clockwise): Ram–Sham–Hari–Kiran–Nitu–Puja. Who sits immediately to the left (counterclockwise) of Puja?
questions.explanation: Puja is at position 6. Counterclockwise (immediate left) = position 5 = **Nitu**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F, G sit in a circle. B is immediately to the right of A. E is immediately to the right of B. D is immediately to the right of E. C is between D and F (D–C–F clockwise). G is between F and A (F–G–A clockwise). Clockwise order: A–B–E–D–C–F–G. Who sits third to the left of D?
questions.explanation: D is at position 4. Third to the left (counterclockwise) = position 4−3 = 1 = **A**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Seven people sit in a circle (clockwise): A–B–E–D–C–F–G. Who sits third to the right of A?
questions.explanation: A is at position 1. Third to the right (clockwise) = position 1+3 = 4 = **D**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Seven people sit in a circle (clockwise): A–B–E–D–C–F–G. Who are the two immediate neighbours of C?
questions.explanation: C is at position 5. Clockwise neighbour = position 6 = F; counterclockwise neighbour = position 4 = D. Neighbours = **D and F**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Seven people sit in a circle (clockwise): A–B–E–D–C–F–G. Who sits immediately to the left (counterclockwise) of E?
questions.explanation: E is at position 3. Counterclockwise (left) = position 2 = **B**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Seven people sit in a circle (clockwise): A–B–E–D–C–F–G. Who sits third to the right of E?
questions.explanation: E is at position 3. Third to the right = position 3+3 = 6 = **F**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Eight people P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, W sit in a circle. P is opposite T. Q is immediately to the right of P. R is between Q and S (Q–R–S clockwise). S is opposite W. U is 4th to the right of Q. U is between T and V (T–U–V clockwise). W is immediately to the right of V. Clockwise order: P–Q–R–S–T–U–V–W. Who sits 3rd to the right of T?
questions.explanation: T is at position 5. Third to the right = position 5+3 = 8 = **W**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Eight people sit in a circle (clockwise): P–Q–R–S–T–U–V–W. [P opp T; S opp W; Q right of P; R between Q and S; U 4th right of Q; T–U–V consecutive; W right of V.] Who sits 2nd to the left of S?
questions.explanation: S is at position 4. Second to the left (counterclockwise) = position 4−2 = 2 = **Q**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Eight people sit in a circle (clockwise): P–Q–R–S–T–U–V–W. How many persons sit between U and P going counterclockwise from U?
questions.explanation: U is at position 6. Going counterclockwise: 5(T), 4(S), 3(R), 2(Q), then 1(P). Persons between U and P = T, S, R, Q = **4 persons**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Eight people sit in a circle (clockwise): P–Q–R–S–T–U–V–W. If P and S swap their seats, who becomes the immediate clockwise (right) neighbour of P's new position?
questions.explanation: P moves to S's original position 4. In the original arrangement, position 5 is T. So T becomes the immediate right neighbour of P's new position = **T**.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Eight people sit in a circle (clockwise): P–Q–R–S–T–U–V–W. Who sits 5th to the right of V?
questions.explanation: V is at position 7. 5th to the right = position 7+5 = 12 ≡ 4 (mod 8) = **S**.
questions.subject: Reasoning
